svg.title: Prompt Engineering Explained
svg.desc: A visual guide to prompt engineering showing what it is, its key techniques, and how they affect AI output quality
svg.text: The art of communicating with AI to get better results

sendPrompt('Show me how to use examples in a prompt')
sendPrompt('How do I use role prompting effectively?')
sendPrompt('What is chain of thought prompting?')
g.text: Ask AI to reason out loud

g.onclick: sendPrompt('How do I iterate on my prompts?')
sendPrompt('Show me a full example of a well-structured prompt')

svg.text: The product is a mobile app…
💡 Tip: The same model gives wildly different outputs depending on how you prompt it.
Prompt engineering is often more impactful than switching models.
